title: DMRdetector pipeline parameters
description: ONT Methylation Analysis Pipeline — DMR detection from Oxford Nanopore WGS

input_output.title: Input/Output
input_output.description: Required input files and output directory.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV with columns: sample_id, type, meth_bed, vcf

gtf.description: Ensembl GTF annotation file (gzipped). Auto-downloaded from Ensembl if not provided.

precomputed_references.title: Pre-computed References
precomputed_references.description: Skip Stages 1-2 by providing pre-built references.

optional_panel.title: Optional Second Panel
optional_panel.description: Optional BED file for a second panel analysis.

atlas_building.title: Reference Atlas Building (Stage 1)
atlas_building.description: Parameters for building the reference atlas from control samples.

atlas_min_samples_per_site.description: Minimum number of samples per CpG site.

atlas_min_read_coverage.description: Minimum read coverage to include a CpG site.

atlas_shrinkage_weight.description: Empirical Bayes shrinkage weight for dispersion.

smooth_sigma_narrow.description: Narrow Gaussian bandwidth (bp) for FFT smoothing.

smooth_sigma_wide.description: Wide Gaussian bandwidth (bp) for FFT smoothing.

cpg_island_detection.title: CpG Island Detection (Stage 2)
cpg_island_detection.description: Parameters for detecting hypomethylated CpG islands.

cpg_max_gap_distance.description: Max gap for clustering and shore detection (bp).

dmr_detection.title: DMR Detection (Stage 3)
dmr_detection.description: Parameters for differentially methylated region detection.

dmr_merge_distance.description: Max gap for merging CpG sites (bp).

dmr_cpg_min_sites.description: Minimum CpG sites for CpG panel.

chromosome_filter.title: Chromosome Filter
chromosome_filter.description: Control which chromosomes are analysed. Autosomes (1-22) are always included.

include_sex_chromosomes.description: Enable v1.3 sex-stratified chrX/chrY analysis: infer sex from VCF, build autosomal, male_X, female_X, and Y component references, and call DMRs against the sex-appropriate components. PAR remains with X/Y. Set to false to restrict analysis to autosomes only.

genome_build.description: Genome build used to select built-in PAR coordinates.

par_bed.description: Override built-in PAR BED (4-col: CHROM START END NAME) used for VCF-based sex inference. Must cover both 'chrX/chrY' and 'X/Y' contig naming.

sex_atlas_min_controls.description: Minimum male or female CTRL count required for sex-specific CASE comparisons.

sex_het_threshold_male.description: Non-PAR chrX HET SNP count below this threshold classifies the sample as male (hemizygous).

sex_het_threshold_female.description: Non-PAR chrX HET SNP count above this threshold classifies the sample as female (diploid). Counts between male and female thresholds are classified as U (autosomes only).

sex_override_tsv.description: Optional 2-column TSV (sample_id, sex) to override VCF-based sex inference (useful for aneuploid karyotypes).

sex_f_ref_meth_min.description: Deprecated compatibility parameter; inactive in v1.3.

sex_f_ref_meth_max.description: Deprecated compatibility parameter; inactive in v1.3.

sex_f_diff_threshold.description: Deprecated compatibility parameter; inactive in v1.3.

sex_f_min_sites.description: Deprecated compatibility parameter; inactive in v1.3.

resource_limits.title: Resource Limits
resource_limits.description: Computational resource limits. Auto-detected by default.

max_cpus.description: Maximum total CPUs. Default: min(80% of cores, RAM_GB / 4).

max_memory.description: Maximum total memory. Default: 80% of system RAM.

apptainer_bind.description: Comma-separated host paths to bind-mount into the container.

tmp_dir.description: Local temp directory for work/tmp files. Sets both workDir and TMPDIR. Recommended when inputs are on network storage.
